title: Alvin Kamara: No bad blood with Saints, I'm going to be ready and we'll see what happens

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Alvin Kamara: No bad blood with Saints, I'm going to be ready and we'll see what happens
sources.description: Saints running back Alvin Kamara has not been attending the team's voluntary workouts this offseason, but he changed things up by showing up for Wednesday's OTA practice.
